translation_pck.scope: Native export-pack and main-pack execution of a minimal project with the same 137 registered translations; not a mobile build.

sources.note: Copied source equality is checked after userdata/editor-plugin transformations. Copy equality does not claim every path was executed.

review_disposition.detail: Deep-copy profile candidates at capture; query-owned copies and side-effect-free missing progress; record all public SaveStore results.
Use validated plan size; require complete puzzle and explicit BoardView setup success before entry commit and actions, including daily/tutorial callers.
Creation ownership and callback validity; popup cancellation completion and safe deferred advancement after destruction; idempotent language connections; layout-driven grouped font fit.
Earned revive remains retryable for this failure presentation; hide/destroy/new presentation ends it; no cross-process receipt claim.
Six native translation keys, 62 PO resources covering 75 existing locales, actual failure UI and exported PCK verification; native-speaker review remains.

Verbose warnings identify active Ogg playback at forced test exit. Stopping players only in exit_tree does not eliminate warnings; stopping earlier and allowing 0.25 seconds to finish does. No speculative audio runtime patch or warning suppression.
Keep explicit field mappings and current page responsibilities under their regressions; no reflection framework or wholesale page split.
Revive regression faults target a newly committed revive receipt rather than global write ordinal and assert actual hit counts. Other narrowly scoped fixtures remain as appropriate.
Synthetic large-save latency does not establish need for storage protocol redesign; preserve atomicity and existing bounded-data checks.

Validate/copy full level catalog once per generation; selected data stays copied; publication/removal/rejection invalidates cache. Benchmark measures repeated missing-level lookup, not all cold or resolved-puzzle costs.

verification_corrections: Initial complete run exposed an old action fixture calling on_show while WindowState remained INVALID. Updated it to real create/show/hide/destroy lifecycle without relaxing production guards or assertions; 88/0 targeted rerun and a new complete frozen run pass.
BoardView setup now returns bool; the old incomplete-tutorial test override was updated to the matching signature, with the actual tutorial boot-failure test rerun.

Cross-review found asynchronous cancellation could wait forever without hidden; covered cancellation completion, external destruction, parent-node mutation lock and earlier event listeners freeing the window.

prior_specialized_verification_not_rerun.scope: Signed HTTP/Spine/production-publication transport suites unchanged and not rerun. Current self-contained content contracts, real page entry, full product startup and new translation PCK export are rerun.

limits: No finite regression run guarantees absence of all defects or all callback interleavings.
Original recovered translations are unchanged; added language strings still need native-speaker and visual review.
In-memory retry is not a durable external receipt when all persistence fails and the process ends.
Some forced-exit tests still emit recorded resource warnings; no claim of sustained runtime leaks or proven absence of leaks.
Native ad bridge, mobile export/touch/background behavior, production CDN/TLS and human visual acceptance remain outside this local run.
